sentences.text:
Versus The State of Andhra Pradesh,
Rep.by its Public Prosecutor.
.... Respondent Counsel for the petitioners : Sri P.Madhu Sudhan Counsel for the respondent :

Assistant Public Prosecutor ORDER:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') seeking to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.148 of 2019 on the file of VI Town Police Station, Nellore, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328,
272, 273, 188 of Indian Penal Code and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006( for short 'FSSA').
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 3 would submit that this is a covered matter in view of the earlier common order passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch, whereby this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

Therefore, he would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed,
are also entitled for quash of the F.I.R.
So, he would pray for quash of the F.I.R., registered against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 3.
The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor fairly submits that the matter can be disposed of in the light of the above mentioned decision.

4. In the light of the above submissions and in view of the aforesaid common order of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the aforesaid F.I.R., registered against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 3, is hereby quashed.
Consequently, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
